source.code:
/--
Returns `true` if the character is an ASCII letter.

The ASCII letters are the following: `ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz`.
-/
@[inline] def isAlpha (c : Char) : Bool :=
  c.isUpper || c.isLower
